mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months compresses the discount rate for equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate lower borrowing costs and increased liquidity.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS has declined over the prior 3 months, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 6.0% in a 3-month window, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE has risen above 6.0% in the prior 3 months, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1000 thousand units and a drop in retail sales (RSAFS) below 425 billion dollars indicates a sharp contraction in consumer demand, which triggers a negative S&P 500 forward return over the next 60 trading days as recession risks increase.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where both HOUST < 1000 and RSAFS < 425 billion, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS rising above 2.5% for 3 consecutive months), the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns over the next 20 trading days as higher interest rates dampen corporate investment and consumer spending.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 2.5% for 3 consecutive months, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) over the past 3 months signals strong labor market conditions that boost consumer confidence and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS has increased over the prior 3 months, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1000 thousand units in a 3-month window, it signals a contraction in the housing sector that reduces consumer wealth and spending, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where HOUST < 1000, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During a labor market recovery phase (UNRATE falling below 5.0% for 3 consecutive months), the S&P 500 experiences positive forward returns over the next 20 trading days as employment gains drive consumer spending and corporate profits.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE < 5.0% for 3 consecutive months, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) rises above 2.5% year-over-year, it signals accelerating inflation that prompts the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
